### 1. Project

This RFP is for one engagement, Structural and civil engineering, covering Structural engineering services and Civil engineering services. One agreement covers every discipline. You may deliver any discipline yourself or through a subconsultant you name in R4. Price each discipline in the fee schedule (section 3).

Hale Capital intends to extend Warehouse (Class 7b) and Mezzanine office (Class 5) at 145-151 Arthur St, Homebush West NSW (Strathfield).

Conditions not yet known: Neighbouring or street trees affected; Works affect trees roots or canopy; Heritage item or conservation area; Basement or deep excavation; Excavation next to adjoining structures or boundaries; Transfer structures; Next to a rail corridor; Super-flat floor needed for the use.

### 2. Scope of services

This engagement covers 2 disciplines. Each part below is that discipline's scope, as it would be issued alone. An item one discipline's scope gives to another discipline in this engagement is shown once, under the discipline that does it, marked within this engagement.

### 2.1 Structural engineering services

You are the structural engineer, engaged by the client and coordinated by the architect. You make the building stand up safely and economically: a structure that carries its loads, suits the architecture and the ground, and can be built and maintained.
To do this you:
- Choose the structural system early with the architect and cost planner, and show what each option means for cost, floor-to-floor height and buildability.
- Design and document the permanent structure with calculations, drawings and specification.
- Coordinate loads, penetrations and set-downs with the geotechnical, civil, services and façade designers before construction.
- Where a specialist contractor designs an element (piles, post-tensioned slabs, specialist floors), write its performance documentation and review the contractor's design; the contractor designs and certifies it.
For the office or retail space, fit for purpose means long, flexible spans and floor loads that let the space be re-let and refitted.
For the warehouse or factory, fit for purpose means clear spans, and slabs that carry the operation's racking, forklift and plant loads.
Because this is work to an existing building, fit for purpose also means establishing what the existing structure can carry before relying on it.

### 2.2 Civil engineering services

You are the civil engineer for the site outside the building footprints. You make the site work: levels, earthworks, roads and pavements, and stormwater that drains safely, meets council's requirements and leaves neighbours no worse off.
To do this you:
- Set the site levels with the architect and landscape architect so the building, access and drainage work together.
- Design and document earthworks, roads and pavements, stormwater and water quality.
- Combine your layouts with the hydraulic engineer's roof drainage, downpipes and pumped systems, and the utility designers' water, sewer, power and communications.
- Design to the traffic engineer's parking numbers, design vehicles and intersection layout.
For the warehouse or factory, fit for purpose means hardstands and pavements that carry the operation's heavy vehicles and their turning paths.
Design vehicle: B-double

### 5. Terms

- Engagement is under AS 4122-2010 as amended by the client's special conditions (attached); your own terms do not apply. List any change you propose to the agreement in R6.
- Only a written instruction from the client's representative authorises extra scope, work beyond an allowance or a fee change; work without one is not paid.
- Each stage ends at client sign-off, which sets the baseline for later stages. Design development within the brief is not a variation; a client change after sign-off is assessed under the agreement.
- Correcting your own errors, or coordinating with information you were given, is not a variation.
- Invoice monthly against stage progress; payment within 30 days, not dependent on any authority approval.
- Your proposal stays valid for 90 days.
- Send questions in writing to Project manager, pm@example.com by 2026-10-23.
- Answers to scope questions go to every tenderer as numbered addenda.
- Structural engineering services: No automatic annual rate increase.
- Structural engineering services: Set-outs and bulk excavation levels are the architect's.
- Civil engineering services: Acceptance by conduct does not adopt your terms.
- Civil engineering services: No provisional sums: price the allowances. Work that depends on an uninvestigated condition is priced as an option.
